title: Hybrid Methods for Friedrichs Systems with Application to Scalar and Vector Diffusion-Advection Problems
summary: In this work we study arbitrary-order hybrid discretizations of Friedrichs systems. Friedrichs systems provide a framework that goes beyond the standard classification of partial differential equations into hyperbolic or elliptic, and are thus particularly suited for problems that include both diffusive and advective terms. The family of numerical schemes proposed in this work hinge on hybrid spaces with unknowns located at elements and faces.
